verdict.rationale: The evidence only loosely touches the story. GitLab says it applies compliance controls and collects audit-ready evidence in every pipeline, lets teams customize development, testing, security and deployment workflows, and puts security findings and code review into merge requests. None of this explicitly describes required approval gates before production. The 'human in the loop approvals' item covers AI agent sessions, not code changes, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented merge request approval rules, protected environments or deployment approvals that block production releases until sign-off, enforcement or policy configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
